# TS9702

> **Reserved: not currently emitted by the compiler.** This code is catalogued, but no
> typesugar check reports it yet. If your build fails, look up the code it actually prints.

**Category:** Import Resolution · **Severity:** Warning

## Message

```
Operator `{operator}` on {type} is not rewritten in explicit mode
```

## Explanation

Reserved: not emitted. It belonged to the "explicit" resolution mode,
which 1.0 doesn't have (the config's resolution.mode is not read; see PEP-052).

An operator on a type with an instance is rewritten only in a file that
activates the typeclass's operator syntax, e.g.
  import "@typesugar/std/syntax/eq/ops";
Without that import the operator stays native and TS9804 says which import to add.
